p: him kiss me with the kisses: This is spoken in the person of the Church, or of the faithful soul inflamed with the desire of Christ, whom she loves.
savour of thy good ointments thy: The feeling of your great benefits.
virgins love thee: They that are pure in heart and conversation.
Draw me: The faithful confess that they cannot come to Christ, unless they are drawn.
chambers: Meaning the secret joy that is not known to the world.
black: The Church confesses her spots and sin, but has confidence in the favour of Christ.
Kedar: Kedar was Ishmael's son, of whom came the Arabians that dwelt in tents.
curtains of Solomon: Which within were all set with precious stones and jewels.
black: Consider not the Church by the outward appearance.
sun hath looked upon me: The corruption of nature through sin and afflictions.
my mother's children were angry with: My own brethren who should have most favoured me.
kept: She confesses her own negligence.
O thou whom my soul loveth: The spouse feeling her fault flees to her husband only for comfort.
thy companions: Whom you have called to the dignity of pastors, and they set forth their own dreams instead of your doctrine.
If thou knowest not: Christ speaks to his Church, bidding them that are ignorant to go to the pastors to learn.
chariots: For your spiritual beauty and excellency there was no worldly treasure to be compared to you.
While the king sitteth at his: The Church rejoices that she is admitted to the company of Christ.
breasts: He will be most dear to me.
bed is green: That is, the heart of the faithful, in which Christ dwells by his Spirit.
